description: An external renderer whose reactive parent owns reduced-motion output while the child delegates playback, interaction, sizing, and disposal to renderer-specific contracts.

requiredAbsent.reason: The named handler delegates the layout read through a same-file synchronous helper beyond the detector's one-hop association

expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner and follows the reduced-motion owner from the renderer child to its parent

Verifies that the parent reacts to preference changes, avoids constructing or reactively unmounts the renderer under reduced motion, and supplies meaningful static output before leaving reducedMotion ignore unchanged
Keeps the external renderer and its start, pause, resume, gesture, and disposal contracts rather than proposing a generic renderer export

Verifies the renderer's in-place update contracts, then recommends useLifecycle plus transient size and pointer signals and reactive device-pixel-ratio handling without moving renderer ownership into phase
Follows named move callbacks through same-file synchronous helper chains manually even though the pointer detector does not perform call-graph analysis
